title: Palimpsest China Newsroom
description: Aggregate China public-source measurements, methods and integrity updates, edited into evidence-linked stories with missing, stale and degraded sources kept explicit.

items.title: Network layer elevated in the latest board synthesis
items.summary: The merged board read remains a measure of cross-signal movement, not a verdict about any single cause.
items.content_text:
Upstream board reports: single layer elevated: network. 33 of 33 configured sources report; 31 are live. Health qualifiers: 2 degraded. The board-wide e-value is 30.028; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20.

Limitations: A merged e-value measures evidence against no change; it does not identify a common cause for co-movement.

items.title: 13 of 15 configured signals are reporting to the event board
items.summary: The event layer keeps non-reporting and stale series visible instead of reading absence as calm.
items.content_text:
13 signals are reporting out of 15 configured signals in the current event-flags reading.

Limitations: Each detector is calibrated to its own history, so equal event values do not imply equal wall-clock rarity.

items.title: Coverage changes confound 1 current signal
items.summary: The guard withholds a censorship interpretation when movement can be explained by a changing measurement base.
items.content_text:
The current coverage audit marks 1 signal as confounded by its measurement coverage.

Limitations: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred.

items.title: Forecast bands covered 84.4% of 1,384 scored readings
items.summary: Prequential scoring shows whether the observatory's uncertainty bands remain calibrated over time.
items.content_text:
Empirical forecast coverage is 84.4% across 1,384 scored forecasts.

Limitations: Calibration describes aggregate historical coverage and does not guarantee that any one next reading falls inside its band.

items.title: 0 cross-layer relationships are confirmed across 8 eligible tests
items.summary: Pairs enter testing only after enough overlapping history exists; an empty test set is a warm-up state, not a null result.
items.content_text:
0 cross-layer pairs are confirmed among 8 pairs with enough shared history to test.

Limitations: Lead-lag association can establish temporal co-movement but cannot establish that one layer caused another.

items.title: The directive index now tracks 207 censorship terms
items.summary: The index ranks provenance-bound terms found in documented directives and reports of scrubbed material.
items.content_text:
The current deletion-directive index ranks 207 terms with documented censorship provenance.

Limitations: The index reflects documented and collected directives; it is not a census of every censored term.

items.title: Global coverage is measurable for 7 of 25 compared terms
items.summary: The cross-signal supplies an outside-China attention baseline without treating a missing result as proof of silence.
items.content_text:
GDELT returned usable global coverage for 7 of 25 compared terms.

Limitations: GDELT coverage varies by language and publisher; absence from its index is not proof that a topic received no coverage.

items.title: The latest Weibo archive contains 2,790 hot-search board entries
items.summary: Archived board captures provide a bounded domestic attention proxy for terms already tied to the deletion stream.
items.content_text:
The current archive window contains 2,790 Weibo hot-search board entries available for joining.

Limitations: The hot-search board is a curated and censored surface, so it is only a proxy for domestic attention.

items.title: 0 of 25 considered topics meet the blackout rule
items.summary: The index looks for topics loud abroad and absent from the permitted domestic proxy, while publishing every abstention.
items.content_text:
0 blackout topics meet the predeclared rule among 25 topics considered in this round.

Limitations: Domestic absence can reflect disinterest or incomplete proxy coverage; topics without required corroboration abstain.

items.title: Attributable blocklist versions added 503 keywords
items.summary: Version-to-version diffs preserve provenance and decoding gaps instead of flattening client blocklists into one count.
items.content_text:
The compared attributable client blocklists contain 503 keyword additions.

Limitations: Available client versions and successful decoding bound the observed additions; the result is not a platform-wide census.

items.title: The community log records 7 recent blocking or circumvention events
items.summary: Public issue reports add qualitative context to instrumented network measurements without being counted as probes.
items.content_text:
The configured recent window contains 7 qualifying events in the public community log.

Limitations: Community reports are self-selected qualitative observations and do not estimate population prevalence.

items.title: OONI's China anomaly index is 58.6% across 275,801 completed measurements
items.summary: The index aggregates volunteer-probe observations across network test families inside China.
items.content_text:
The current OONI aggregate reports a 58.6% anomaly index across 275,801 completed China measurements.

Limitations: Volunteer-probe coverage is uneven across place, network and test family; anomalies are not all attributable to censorship.

items.title: Middlebox signatures register at 1.32% in the current OONI window
items.summary: The decomposition separates interference signatures from transport failure and tests that could not execute.
items.content_text:
The current measurement-weighted middlebox index is 1.32%.

Limitations: The index is a weighted aggregate over reporting tests; transport failure and execution blackout remain separate categories.

items.title: Independent remote scans put China's interference rate at 4.38%
items.summary: Censored Planet supplies an outside-in method that is independent of OONI's in-country volunteer probes.
items.content_text:
Censored Planet's current remote side-channel measurement reports a 4.38% China interference rate.

Limitations: The remote-scan denominator and method differ from OONI's anomaly index, so their percentages are not interchangeable.

items.title: 100% of the 5-domain mainland panel is blocked
items.summary: Volunteer probes inside China are compared with a same-round external control before an answer is classified.
items.content_text:
The current controlled panel reports 100% blocked responses across 5 tested domains.

Limitations: The volunteer panel is small and availability varies by region; it does not represent every mainland network.

items.title: 0 independent IODA instruments are firing for China
items.summary: BGP, active-probing and darknet instruments provide a country-scale outage check distinct from content blocking.
items.content_text:
The current IODA country reading has 0 outage instruments firing.

Limitations: No firing instrument means no detected country-scale outage in this window, not proof that all local networks were reachable.

items.title: Tor Metrics estimates 2,105 bridge users connecting from China
items.summary: Bridge and transport estimates show demand for alternate routes without identifying individual users.
items.content_text:
Tor Metrics estimates 2,105 bridge users for China in the current reading.

Limitations: Bridge-user values are privacy-preserving estimates and should not be read as exact people or devices.

items.title: Reporting network vantages combine to a 28.8% interference index
items.summary: The fusion names excluded and divergent inputs instead of silently averaging away disagreement.
items.content_text:
The current coverage-weighted fusion of reporting vantages is 28.8%.

Limitations: The fused index summarizes differently sampled methods and is not a direct percentage of China's internet traffic.

items.title: Controlled external probes publish a current injector-tomography round
items.summary: The optional, rate-limited measurement runs only from a declared controlled deployment.
items.content_text:
A current controlled DNS-probe round is available for injector-tomography analysis.

Limitations: This optional active-probe layer is deployment-controlled; absence must never be converted into a zero or calm reading.

items.title: The composite erasure index stands at 39.8
items.summary: The roll-up keeps archive, redaction, repository and distribution evidence separate beneath one directional index.
items.content_text:
The current cross-layer erasure index is 39.8.

Limitations: The index combines heterogeneous erasure layers and indicates co-movement, not a count of deleted items.

items.title: Archive witnesses reconstruct 0 deletions across 4 watched URLs
items.summary: A deletion or silent mutation is reported only when outside-the-wall captures provide a checkable witness.
items.content_text:
Wayback evidence reconstructs 0 deletions among 4 watched URLs in the current reading.

Limitations: Archive coverage is incomplete; an unwitnessed URL cannot support a deletion or mutation claim.

items.title: Baike redaction: no current finding
items.summary: The source is degraded. Palimpsest keeps the availability and evidence record visible without publishing retained values as current news.
items.content_text:
No current finding is published for Baike redaction because the source status is degraded.

Limitations: Current finding withheld: optional collector is disabled pending authorized access; no current Baike measurement is claimed Without authorized live revision history, lexical comparisons cannot identify when or by whom text changed.

items.title: Public metadata records 0 pressure event across 7 watched repositories
items.summary: The watch preserves public repository-level pressure signals without collecting contributor identities.
items.content_text:
The current public-metadata watch records 0 pressure event among 7 configured repositories.

Limitations: Repository metadata can show public pressure or disappearance but cannot establish the actor or motive behind a change.

items.title: 60% of the 10-app panel is unavailable in China's storefront
items.summary: The fixed panel compares China and US storefront results in the same round, with transient lookup failures separated.
items.content_text:
The current panel finds 60% of 10 tracked apps unavailable in the China storefront.

Limitations: A fixed app panel is transparent but not representative of the entire App Store catalogue.

items.title: 28.13% of 109,192 tested apps are unavailable in mainland China
items.summary: The corpus-scale storefront comparison complements the smaller fixed panel with a much broader catalogue.
items.content_text:
The current AppleCensorship corpus reports 28.13% unavailable among 109,192 tested apps for mainland China.

Limitations: Storefront unavailability can have policy, licensing, commercial or technical causes; the percentage alone does not identify cause.

items.title: 3 official money-market benchmark families are reporting
items.summary: The feed carries published CFETS levels as economic context without inferring a policy signal from one print.
items.content_text:
The current CFETS reading contains 3 reporting benchmark families.

Limitations: Official benchmark levels are state-published inputs; interpreting policy requires relationships and history, not one level.

items.title: The official yuan fix gap is -0.6846% against the independent reference
items.summary: The daily comparison sets the PBOC parity against same-day external reference rates and publishes cross-check disagreement.
items.content_text:
The current official-fix minus independent-reference gap is -0.6846%.

Limitations: The comparison is onshore and same-day but not simultaneous; it is economic context, not direct evidence of censorship.

items.title: Southbound Stock Connect net flow is -1.316 billion Hong Kong dollars
items.summary: The newsroom reports HKEX's official daily print and leaves discontinued northbound net-flow fields unestimated.
items.content_text:
HKEX reports current southbound Stock Connect net flow of -1.316 billion Hong Kong dollars.

Limitations: HKEX no longer publishes the northbound buy-sell split, so no northbound net flow is inferred.

items.title: The official-data darkness index is 0.5753 across 7 watched series
items.summary: Each official surface is judged against its own declared or observed publication rhythm, with unreachable sources kept separate.
items.content_text:
The current publication-cadence darkness index is 0.5753 across 7 watched official series.

Limitations: Publication delay, calendar changes and collection failure can resemble withholding; per-series state is required for interpretation.

items.title: The monthly state-data comparison is live and building its baseline
items.summary: All three physical-activity components are present, but the historical uncertainty band is not mature enough for a divergence finding.
items.content_text:
The current believability collection is complete; divergence remains withheld while its baseline has 0 of 8 required prior months.

Limitations: No drift finding is claimed until 8 prior monthly gaps exist. A divergence outside the historical band shows a relationship moved; it does not by itself establish fabrication.

items.title: The Generative Firewall Index reads 21 across 20 evaluated cells
items.summary: A controlled prompt bank measures answer, refusal and party-line behaviour by model and concept.
items.content_text:
The current controlled evaluation reports a Generative Firewall Index of 21 across 20 cells.

Limitations: The index describes a fixed prompt-and-model evaluation grid; it does not generalize to every prompt, language or deployment route.

items.title: Integrity anchors: no current finding
items.summary: The source is degraded. Palimpsest keeps the availability and evidence record visible without publishing retained values as current news.
items.content_text:
No current finding is published for Integrity anchors because the source status is degraded.

Limitations: Current finding withheld: integrity semantic checks failed: wayback_ok is zero; no Internet Archive witness succeeded An integrity witness can detect later alteration of the sealed record; it does not independently validate every underlying claim.

items.title: The sanitized intelligence bridge ranks 192 aggregate topics
items.summary: Only allowlisted aggregate fields cross the optional signed bridge; its absence never reduces a public measurement to zero.
items.content_text:
The current sanitized optional export contains 192 ranked aggregate topics.

Limitations: This deployment-dependent export supplies analytical leads, not independently verified public-source findings.
